latest.content:
Today 16:39

16 September 2026
ALTERNATIVE LIQUIDITY FUND LIMITED

LEI NUMBER 213800R5CHD76J3LU713
Registered Office:
1 Royal Plaza, Royal Avenue,
St Peter Port, Guernsey, GY1 2HL
16 September 2026
RECEIPT OF FUNDS and FINAL RETURN OF CAPITAL
The Board of Directors of Alternative Liquidity Fund Limited (the "
Company
") is pleased to announce that the Company has received the expected proceeds from the sale of its position in Vision Special Opportunities Eletrobrás Fund. The Company has now realised all its portfolio assets.
Consequently, the Board will convene an Extraordinary General Meeting ("
EGM
") of shareholders to consider and, if thought fit, approve resolutions to place the Company into Guernsey Members' Voluntary Liquidation ("
GMVL
"), appoint liquidators, and agree the liquidators' remuneration. The notice of EGM will be circulated to direct, registered shareholders shortly.
The Company will bear its running costs for the next few weeks and will need to cover the liquidator's costs and other expenses until the liquidation is complete. Therefore, it has been resolved to return an amount of US$ 2.91 cents per share ($0.0291) to shareholders, being US$4.252 million in total, based on the current number of shares in issue.
The return of capital will be effected by way of an issue of redeemable B shares to existing shareholders
pro-rata
to their shareholding on the record date set out below and the subsequent redemption and cancellation of those B Shares.
Following the distribution, the Company's remaining assets are expected to comprise only the cash retained to meet the costs and expenses of the proposed GMVL, together with an appropriate contingency reserve.
The Board confirms that Benjamin Rhodes and Oliver Beaton of Grant Thornton Advisors Limited have been selected as the proposed Joint Liquidators, subject to shareholder approval at the EGM. The London Stock Exchange ("
LSE
"
)
has been notified of the proposed appointment of the liquidators.
Subject to shareholder approval of the liquidation and the appointment of the Joint Liquidators at the EGM, the Company's shares will be suspended upon commencement of liquidation; the Company intends that the cancellation of the Company's admission to trading on the LSE will take place immediately following the EGM or as soon as practicable thereafter. Immediately following the Joint Liquidators' appointment, the powers of the Company's directors shall cease, except to the extent that the Joint Liquidators sanction the directors to undertake certain actions.
It is expected that the timetable for the return of capital will be as follows:
17 September 2026
Ex date
18 September 2026
Record date for shareholders on the register to receive B shares
21 September 2026
B shares allotted and issued to shareholders on the register as at the Record date
22 September 2026
B shares redeemed and cancelled
6 October 2026
Redemption payment made
All redemption payments will be paid gross of tax.

SHAREHOLDER UPDATE
Dear Shareholders
As previously discussed, the Board committed to updating shareholders on the Company's portfolio monetisation strategy and the ensuing plan for the orderly liquidation of the Company.We are pleased to announce that the previously mentioned sale of the Vision FCVS RJ Fund to Vision has now progressed to the final stages of legal completion, and we expect to sign a definitive agreement within the next few weeks. This transaction is expected to trigger a redemption payment from the Vision RJ Cayman Fund to ALF and the other shareholders in the Vision FCVS RJ Fund.
Following completion of that transaction, the Board will seek to sell the Vision Special Credit Opportunities Eletrobras Fund in the secondary market. We anticipate that the process will progress relatively quickly since indicative bids for the asset have already been received.The proceeds from both these transactions will be combined to facilitate a final distribution to shareholders. At that point, the Board intends to convene an Extraordinary General Meeting to seek shareholder approval for the Company to enter voluntary liquidation.The Board expects to provide a further update in the near future once a definitive legal agreement has been signed.
